# Denkovi smartDEN IP Devices

Control Denkovi smartDEN IP devices in Home Assistant.  

- Models: smartDEN IP-16R, smartDEN IP-32IN, smartDEN IP-Maxi-XX, smartDEN IP-PLC and DAEnetIP4
- Tested with Home Assistant 2026.10, IP-16R and IP-32IN
- Reads and controls the device through its JSON API

## Installation

[![Open your Home Assistant instance and open this repository in HACS.](https://my.home-assistant.io/badges/hacs_repository.svg)](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/hacs_repository/?owner=horzadome&repository=denkovi_smartden_ip_hass&category=integration)

1. Click the above button to install the integration through HACS.
2. If needed, restart Home Assistant.
3. Add devices at **Settings -> Devices & Services** -> Denkovi smartDEN IP Devices.

For more information check the [README](https://github.com/horzadome/denkovi_smartden_ip_hass#installation).  
If this integration is useful to you,
[a donation](https://github.com/horzadome/denkovi_smartden_ip_hass#donations) is very welcome.
